abilities.name: Two for One
abilities.description: As your Basic Action, you may pay 3 Hope to play 2 cards at once.

abilities.name: Bulk Discount
abilities.description: Two for One's Hope cost drops to 0.

abilities.name: Full House
abilities.description: Two for One's cards can now be played as a Free Action instead of your Basic Action.

abilities.name: Know Your Enemy
abilities.description: At the start of each encounter, before turns begin, name one tag from the Move Tags list in Chapter 11. Until the end of the round, your partner Digimon takes -2 damage from attacks using that tag.

abilities.name: Piggyback
abilities.description: Whenever an allied Tamer plays a card as their Basic Action, you may spend your own action on their turn to play a card using Two for One. If you do, both cards' effects apply to both your partner Digimon and their partner Digimon. The allied Tamer plays one card, and you play one card; Two for One does not allow you to play two cards yourself, it combines your card with the allied Tamer's card.

abilities.name: Know a Guy
abilities.description: Once between rests, make an Archive skill check. Your total determines what you find: 1 to 10 gets you a Common card, 11 to 20 gets you an Uncommon card, 21 to 29 gets you a Rare card, and 30 or higher gets you a Secret Rare card. The GM chooses the specific card within that rarity, not you.
